name: Hotel Moraine
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Hotel, so no opening hours (check-in 4 PM, check-out 11 AM per Google). Music here is a solo acoustic happy hour, not a dance band; we found no dance floor. The site sometimes shows 'Closed for a Private Event' days. Photos chosen show the property; the site has no photo of the music area.
description: A family-owned resort hotel on a bluff over Long Island Sound on County Road 48 in Greenport. On many Saturdays it holds a 5-7 PM happy hour with a live acoustic musician, plus yoga and other public events.

logo.alt: Hotel Moraine logo: a rounded stone-like emblem beside the words Hotel Moraine in dark gray

photos.alt: Aerial view at dusk of Hotel Moraine's white buildings and lawn on a wooded bluff above the waves of Long Island Sound
The hotel's long outdoor pool with lounge chairs and umbrellas, looking out to the Sound

Events calendar: Saturday happy hours 5-7 PM with live music (e.g. Como Brothers Oct 3, Jeff LeBlanc Oct 10, Nick Kerzner Oct 17, 2026), yoga and art events; some days closed for private events.
